home.description: Left-rail Library workspace overview with collections, project cards, search, view/sort controls, and New Draft.

nodes.title: Archive Brand
nodes.notes: Destructive; do not use on existing user brands.

nodes.title: Template Editor
nodes.notes: Opened by creating or selecting a brand template.

nodes.title: Media picker
nodes.notes: Full overlay gallery of workspace media; bottom upload button opens local file chooser.

nodes.title: Screen Recording Settings
nodes.notes: Reached from Project actions > Screen Clip Settings...

nodes.title: Shadow
nodes.notes: Opacity, blur, spread, X and Y offset.

nodes.title: Sound Effects
nodes.notes: Cursor Clicks checkbox + softness; Keyboard Presses checkbox + sound set/preview + softness.

nodes.title: Background Track
nodes.notes: Selection applies immediately and closes picker.

nodes.title: Upload Background Track
nodes.notes: Unlabeled upload-from-computer button at bottom of picker; invokes local file selection.

nodes.title: Add Reference...
nodes.notes: Opens native macOS Open chooser for a local file.

nodes.title: Version History
nodes.notes: Lists timestamps/authors; warns that reverting can be undone.

nodes.title: Overlay template picker
nodes.notes: Shows templates from the draft's selected brand; can be empty.

nodes.title: New Blank Overlay
nodes.notes: Immediately creates a 4-second overlay scene and enters overlay editing.

nodes.title: Projects category
nodes.notes: Lists workspace projects/drafts as addable buttons with timestamps; selecting adds user content to current project.

nodes.title: Draft sort options
nodes.notes: Selection applies immediately to the Your Drafts overview.

nodes.title: Screen recording helper flow
nodes.notes: Opened by the bottom record-screen button; separate helper/window may take over accessibility and should be treated cautiously.

nodes.title: Delete Collection
nodes.notes: Only item in collection header ellipsis; destructive.

edges.action: App opens here; click "Library" in the left rail to return.
Click "Brand Kits" in the left rail.
Click a brand kit entry such as "Default Brand · Primary".
click a swatch or add-swatch tile labeled "Open paint picker"
click the Cursor Style combo box
click Motion in the Brand Kit section list
click Layout in the Brand Kit section list
click Misc in the Brand Kit section list
click Workflows in the Brand Kit section list
click a workflow row, or click New Workflow for an empty editor
select an existing template or click New Template
click Text; a new text layer is inserted and selected
open a draft card, Your Drafts item, or an open draft tab
click Project actions, then Screen Clip Settings...
click the captions icon in the top status bar
click Open paint picker in the top status bar
Click the top music-notes popup (label is Add Music or current track name).
Click Select voice in the left panel header.
click the bottom overlay/template insert icon
click See All to reveal advanced properties
click Your Drafts in the left rail
click the unlabeled sort popup beside Grid/List
click the current workspace name at top left
enter a name and click Create Workspace
name it, optionally choose a color, then click “Create Collection”
click the bottom record screen clip button
